title: SEKA China warranty and service policy recheck
notes: Current China policy states lifetime warranty for SEKA frames, five years for SEKA carbon parts and two years for SEKA spare parts. China scope covers mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan; mainland buyers needing overseas service pay outbound shipping. Mainland claim route directs customers to their retailer, official WeChat or official Taobao. This policy does not establish warranty coverage for a complete build's non-SEKA components.
